svg.title: SIZANBD — E-commerce
svg.desc: Gadget store for official, verified phones, laptops, audio and accessories, backed by a showroom in Dhaka. Built with React, TypeScript, React Query, Zustand, Tailwind. Live at sizanbd.vercel.app. Last updated Oct 11, 2026.

g.text: backed by a showroom in Dhaka.
